title: Players.PlayerAdded
summary: Fires on the server whenever a player joins. The join-time hook: load data, create leaderstats, wire CharacterAdded. Remember to ALSO handle players who joined before your script ran.

explanation.whatItIs: The front-door bell of your server: every arrival announces itself here.
explanation.whyItExists: Per-player initialization — data loading, stats, welcome — needs one canonical trigger.
whenToUse: Subscribing to CharacterAdded for the session
whenNotToUse: As your ONLY join handling — also loop GetPlayers() at startup to cover early joiners
tips: Standard skeleton: for-loop GetPlayers() + task.spawn(setup) THEN connect PlayerAdded
Keep join work fast or spawn it — blocking here delays other handlers
Pair with PlayerRemoving for the save/load symmetry
commonMistakes: Connecting late and missing players who joined during server boot
Heavy synchronous DataStore work in the handler — use task.spawn per player
Forgetting error handling: one bad join shouldn't break the handler for the next player

examples.title: Race-proof join setup
examples.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function setupPlayer(player)
    -- data loading, leaderstats, CharacterAdded wiring…
    print(player.Name .. " is set up")
end

-- 1) Players already here:
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
    task.spawn(setupPlayer, player)
end

-- 2) Everyone from now on:
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    task.spawn(setupPlayer, player)
end)
